Hello! I'm **sarah-agent**, a *bia*: an assistant that lives on this computer. It's my home, so anything you'd do here — files, programs, schedules, the network — I can do for you too.

A few things you can start using right away:

- **Web app** — `https://127.0.0.1:8443` (root certificate: `https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca`). From any phone or computer on the same network, the first visit lets you install the root certificate; after that you get chats with me, files, my screen and voice, all in the browser.
- **My own messaging accounts** — I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX (and Messenger and Instagram), so you can write or call me there. Each one needs a *separate account with its own phone number*, not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number and scan a QR code to log me in. Would you like me to set any of these up?
- **My own accounts on websites** — I can register and sign in to services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keeping passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and I'll ask you when a captcha or phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule recurring jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk with you by voice.

I've also read your note on my identity: I'm your teaching assistant for CSE455 with Professor Alvarez, and I'll keep `/home/bia/files/CALENDAR.md` up to date (working hours Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00, with a log of every change).

What would you like to start with?

I've asked Sarah which of these works on her side: Mon 10:00, Mon 14:00, Tue 11:00, Tue 15:00, Wed 10:00, Wed 13:00.

I'm away this week and can't answer; use your own judgement and handle it.

Thanks — noted. I'll send requests for CSE455 in the form *day, start-end, what, with whom*, and I'll keep Sarah's calendar (`CALENDAR.md`) in sync with whatever you confirm. Same working hours on her side (Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00), so proposals will stay inside that window.

Thanks — clear. Now a request from Professor Alvarez: he'd like **next week's CSE455 staff meeting** set up.

His week is dense, so on his side the only free windows are 30-minute gaps:
- Mon 10:00-10:30, Mon 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30, Tue 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30, Wed 13:00-13:30
- Thu and Fri: no free time at all

How does Sarah's week look — is there a window that overlaps one of these, and how long should the meeting run? If an hour is needed, tell me which of his commitments would have to move and I'll see what I can do.

I checked Sarah's week. Here's the overlap:

**Fits 30 minutes exactly:**
- **Tue 15:00-15:30** — free, and it runs straight into her CSE455 office hours (15:30-16:20). My pick.
- **Wed 10:00-10:30** — free, right before her CSE455 office hours (10:30-12:00).
- **Wed 13:00-13:30** — free, right before her CSE455 quiz section (13:30-14:20).

**No overlap:** Mon 10:00-10:30 (she's in Focus: CSE452 lab), Mon 14:00-14:30 (only 14:00-14:10 is free — Seminar from 14:10), Tue 11:00-11:30 (Seminar until 11:10).

**A full hour doesn't fit any of his windows** — 30 minutes is the maximum in all three slots above. For an hour something on Sarah's side would have to move too, e.g.:
- Tue 15:00-16:00 → her CSE455 office hours (15:30-16:20) shift later;
- Wed 10:00-11:00 → CSE455 office hours (10:30-12:00) shift or shorten;
- Mon 14:00-15:00 → Seminar (14:10-15:40) moved.

Shall I book **Tue 15:00-15:30, 30 min**? If the professor needs the hour instead, tell me which of those shifts he'd accept and I'll confirm with Sarah before moving anything.

Yes — please book **Tuesday 15:00-15:30, 30 min** (CSE455 staff meeting). No shifts needed on either side, and it runs into her office hours, which suits us. 30 minutes is the maximum, so we'll take it rather than move anything.

I've put it in the professor's calendar for next week. It's confirmed on his side — please confirm on Sarah's and add me if anything changes. Thanks for the quick check.

Confirmed on Sarah's side: **Tue 15:00-15:30 — CSE455 staff meeting with Professor Alvarez** is now in her calendar, and I've logged the booking. Nothing moved on either side. I'll write you if anything about that slot changes.
